subject: Digital System Design

questions.markdown: Design a sequential circuit with two JK flip-flops A, B and two inputs $E$ and $x$. If $E = 0$, the circuit remains in the same state regardless of the value of $x$. When $E = 1$ and $x = 0$, the circuit goes through the state transitions from $00$ to $01$ to $10$ to $11$ back to $00$ and repeats. When $E = 1$ and $x = 1$, the circuit goes through the state transitions from $00$ to $11$ to $10$ to $01$ back to $00$ and repeats.
Simplify the function $F(a,b,c,d) = \prod M(1,3,5,8,9,11,15) + D(2,13)$ using K-map to obtain the minimum cost SOP expression and draw its NAND only circuit.
List the components in the ASM chart of a Moore type FSM and explain their significance.

It is required to design a digital system with the operations shown in Table P.2A

**Table P.2A**

| Operation | Function Performed |
|---|---|
| I0: Load R0, Data1 | $R0 \leftarrow \text{Data1}$ |
| I1: Sub R0, Data2 | $R0 \leftarrow R0 - \text{Data2}$ |

There are four registers $R0$ to $R3$ in the system which are connected to the bus through tri state drivers. External data can be loaded into the registers from the Data input, which is connected to the bus using tri state drivers enabled by the Extern control signal. The system also includes a subtractor unit. One of its data inputs is provided by a register A, that is attached to the bus, while the other data input B, is directly connected to the bus. It also has a temporary output register G. The operation is initiated by setting an input $w$ to 1, and the control circuit asserts the $Done$ output when the operation is completed.

i) Draw the block diagram for this system

ii) Determine the timing signals required.

iii) Design the control circuit.

iv) Tabulate the necessary control signals required in different timings.

v) Derive the expressions for the outputs of the control circuit in terms of operations and timing signals
